review.notes: Whole-document normalized word diff of the OCR against all 25 pages of extracted PDF text; targeted renders at 150-300 dpi of physical pages 1 (dropped author footnotes) and 8 (run-in heading 'Improving Training Stability'). All 21 figure captions, Tables 1-2 values (74.2/74.3/95.4/86.6/59.0 ... 63.3) and the reference list token set were verified against the text layer; the remaining tables and bilingual figure examples were only coarsely diffed.

unresolved.evidence: Figures 8-10 recaptioning/multi-turn dialogue examples contain long bilingual prompt strings that exist only inside the figure images; the PDF text layer shows them but the OCR correctly leaves them to the embedded figures.
